# proxmox_guest_template (Resource)

Converts a guest into a template through `POST /nodes/{node}/{type}/{vmid}/template`. Destroy does not revert the template flag.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "proxmox_guest_template" "base" {
  type     = "qemu"
  node     = "pve"
  vmid     = 100
  disks    = ["scsi0"]
  triggers = { revision = "1" }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `node` (String)
- `triggers` (Map of String)
- `type` (String)
- `vmid` (Number)

### Optional

- `disks` (List of String)

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
